title: Grateful Dead Live at Aarhus University on 1972-04-16

ai_review.summary: Soundboard tape with a touch of hiss delivers a high‑energy show highlighted by a monster Truckin' and an adventurous Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording, captured from the soundboard, shows a modest amount of tape hiss that benefits from good bass response and a solid subwoofer setup. Musically the concert shines in the second set – a ripping Truckin', a wildly inventive The Other One jam, and a high‑octane Me & My Uncle that rank among the tour’s best. Overall the show is praised as an exciting, memorable performance despite the modest recording quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and highlighted strong musical moments; recording quality is good but not pristine, yielding a solid overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape hiss present; benefits from decent subwoofer and volume. Sound is clear enough for the performance, though not immaculate.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set dominates with extended jams; first‑set material is solid but less emphasized. Transitions are smooth, especially the NFA > GDTRFB finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for a tight duet with Phil on Truckin' and for strumming unique melodic chords during The Other One.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass described as percolating and forming an excellent duet with Jerry on Truckin'.
